contract: Call rotation classification, character lookup, advance and extents directly for the two Arimo alias pairs of ass-render at its effective 54- and 81-pixel sizes.

Read exact glyph IDs, advances and extents from the pinned FreeType default load. Public libass frames identify whether the selected advance is horizontal or vertical when a character loads the glyph first. Allow one output pixel for the marker origin when distinguishing the two advances, and compare the chosen 26.6 metric exactly.

The documented first-lookup rule gives the horizontal advance to a glyph first loaded by ID for an advance or extents. Repeated lookups and new handles to the same key retain the first decision; a second key decides independently.

open_unmeasured.cause: The direct lookup comparison uses rendered images to select the reference advance. The ASS renderer workloads measure the rendering path.
